answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil resistance is achieved by mandating that every agent must lock a minimum stake inside a unique on-chain vault tied to a physical karst-hosted sensor node. An attacker seeking many identities must therefore purchase separate hardware units and capital for each one; a raven scanning the velvet terrain of the network would quickly flag repeated signal patterns, making the economic cost of fabricating clones exceed any benefit from flooding consensus or markets.
